description: This file contains SCSS mixins designed for a grid system, including flexbox-based row and column layouts, auto-sizing, offsetting, and CSS grid support, used by a Bootstrap-like framework.

methods.name: make-row
methods.description: Creates a flex container with wrapping, gutter spacing, and negative margins to align grid columns.

methods.name: make-col-ready
methods.description: Prepares columns with full width, box-sizing, and padding to fit into the grid.

methods.name: make-col
methods.description: Defines column flex properties and width based on size and total columns.

methods.name: make-col-offset
methods.description: Offsets columns by a specified number of columns.

methods.name: row-cols
methods.description: Sets child elements to span equal columns with flex behavior.

methods.name: make-grid-columns
methods.description: Generates grid column classes for responsive breakpoints, including offset and gutter utilities.

methods.name: make-cssgrid
methods.description: Defines grid column classes for CSS Grid layouts across breakpoints.
